title: Equipment Master Data UI Refinement & Price Investigation
summary_context: Investigated price sources for rental and purchase, finding they come from Catalog CSV or Manual Edit. Restructured the EquipmentTable UI into a premium dropdown-based layout with filters on the left and actions on the right. Added a new API for downloading the inventory template Excel file.
achievements: Identified buy_price and rent_price sources (CSV col 5,6).
Implemented Vertical Dropdown Menus for Catalog and Stock management.
Optimized header layout with Filters-Left and Actions-Right configuration.
